inputs.text: This whole US-Israel-Iran thing is clearly another scripted operation by the hidden elites to lock down their control. The US floated that 15-point ceasefire plan through Pakistan as a fake olive branch, but Iran hit back with five conditions demanding an end to the aggression, compensation, and full recognition of their sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz. Israel's predictable doubt and talk of pre-emptive strikes slot right into the plan. Don't buy any of the official noise about halting the fighting—it's all coordinated to manufacture endless conflict, destabilize the region, and let the real powers keep dictating terms for their own profit and dominance.
